concurrency_and_state: Every boss subclass with custom damage handling declares `synchronized long injured(...)`, acquiring the boss monitor on the caller thread (typically Netty worker/game loop) during combat.
SAIBAMEN.setBom(plAtt) (called from synchronized injured() at line 119) busy-spins in `while (this.playerSkill.prepareTuSat)` for 2500ms while holding the boss monitor and blocking the caller thread.
CADICH.attack() (line 211) and SAIBAMEN.afk() (line 72) call `Functions.sleep(2000)` / `Functions.sleep(1500)`, blocking the boss update loop thread.
Mabu2H maintains `public List<Player> maBuEat = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>()`, which is accessed and cleared by both Mabu2H.die() and SuperBu.die().

SuperBu.injured() (synchronized on SuperBu) delegates to Mabu2H.injured() (synchronized on Mabu2H) via FinalBossManager before checking its own isDie(), while Mabu2H.injured() looks up SuperBu on death and calls changeStatus(BossStatus.DIE).
NinjaAoTim.injured() mutates `clan.doanhTrai.bosses.add(new NinjaClone(...))` from the combat caller thread.

Bosses use non-volatile timer/state fields (lastTimeAttack, lastTimeAfk, lastTimeUpdate/st, stateTimer, isEnraged, calledNinja, isLaze, currentState) read/written between boss update ticks and synchronized injured().
cross_module_questions: Does Zone.getNotBosses(), Zone.getPlayers(), and Zone.getBosses() return a thread-safe snapshot/CopyOnWriteArrayList, or a mutable ArrayList that can throw ConcurrentModificationException during boss skill/aura loops?
Does Boss clone BossesData entries per instance, or does Raiti.enrage() calling `this.data[this.currentLevel].setSecondsRest(1)` mutate a shared static BossData across all Raiti spawns?
Does ChangeMapService.changeMap(..., 127, ...) reset `pl.isMabuHold = false`, or do players released from Mabu2H/SuperBu stay stuck with `isMabuHold = true`?
How does `Boss.injured` caller handle the return value when `injured` returns `(int) damage` (truncated from `long`) for uncapped high-HP bosses?
Is `clan.doanhTrai.bosses` thread-safe when NinjaAoTim.injured() adds 4-6 NinjaClone instances from a player attack thread?

What happens in `Player.injured` / `BossManager` when `SAIBAMEN.setBom` sets `this.nPoint.hp = 0` and then busy-waits 2.5s before calling `setDie(this); die(plAtt);`? Can another thread observe `isDie() == true` or skip `setBom`?

findings.impact: Freezes the attacking player's handler thread (and wastes 100% of a CPU core) for 2.5 seconds on every Saibamen suicide death, risking Netty event-loop/thread-pool stalls or timeouts.
findings.root_cause: SAIBAMEN.injured() (synchronized) calls setBom(plAtt) directly when isDie() becomes true, and setBom() executes a busy-wait `while (this.playerSkill.prepareTuSat)` loop checking Util.canDoWithTime(..., 2500) instead of transitioning to a boss update state. Also dereferences plAtt without null check in Service.gI().chat(plAtt, ...) and startStun(plAtt, ...).
findings.title: Busy-wait 2.5s spin-loop inside synchronized SAIBAMEN.injured/setBom blocks caller thread and spikes CPU

findings.impact: Stalls the boss manager / zone update tick for 1.5s-2s whenever CADICH transforms or SAIBAMEN #1 wakes up, delaying AI and timeouts for other bosses on the same thread.
findings.root_cause: Direct calls to Functions.sleep(2000) inside CADICH.attack() and Functions.sleep(1500) inside SAIBAMEN.afk().
findings.title: Blocking Thread.sleep calls inside boss AI update methods (CADICH, SAIBAMEN)

findings.impact: Drabura2 never dies through normal combat; players receive no fightMabu point reward, no item drops, and no boss-kill task completion.
findings.root_cause: In Drabura2.injured(), `if (damage >= this.nPoint.hp)` sets status to BossStatus.AFK and resets `damage = 0` before `subHP(damage)`. Thus `isDie()` is never true, `die(plAtt)` / `reward(plAtt)` are bypassed, and `afk()` immediately switches to BossStatus.DIE.
findings.title: Drabura2 resets lethal damage to 0 and skips die()/reward()

findings.impact: Cadic dodges 100% of all non-piercing attacks whenever tlNeDon >= 1, making him nearly unkillable except by piercing skills.
findings.title: Cadic dodge roll uses denominator 1 instead of 100/1000

findings.impact: Can throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException during boss reward() if LuongLong arrays are shorter than Kaio arrays, or IllegalArgumentException if any array length <= 1; also never drops the last array element.
findings.root_cause: Lines 247/250 (Cadic) and 248/251 (Goku) index `itemIds_LuongLong_AWJ[randomDo]` and `itemIds_LuongLong_GN[randomDo1]` using Kaio-bounded random indices instead of `randomDo2` and `randomDo3`, and `new Random().nextInt(len - 1)` excludes the final index.
findings.title: Wrong array indices and off-by-one Random bound in Cadic.reward and Goku.reward

findings.impact: Throws NullPointerException on non-player damage (e.g. burn/DoT/boss-vs-boss) or when fightMabu is null, interrupting damage application or reward logic.
findings.root_cause: `plAtt.isPl()` and `plAtt.fightMabu.changePercentPoint(...)` / `plKill.fightMabu.changePoint(...)` are called without null-checking `plAtt` or `fightMabu`.
findings.title: Missing null checks on plAtt and fightMabu in MajinBuu12H/14H bosses

findings.impact: Damage exceeding Integer.MAX_VALUE overflows/truncates to negative or incorrect ints when returned from injured(); SuperRank Rival HP/damage is capped at 2.14B instead of using long stats.
findings.location: src/models/boss/boss_list/SuperRank/Rival.java:36-43; all 23 injured() overrides (e.g. BuiBui2.java:214, CADICH.java:191, NinjaAoTim.java:140, Pocolo.java:109)
findings.root_cause: All 23 overridden `injured()` methods cast `long damage` to `(int) damage` on return; `Rival.bossData()` uses `NPoint.safeInt()` and `new int[]{hpMax}` instead of `long`.
findings.title: (int) damage truncation in injured() overrides and 32-bit stat clamping in SuperRank Rival

findings.impact: Yacon teleports to Y=10000 (far off-map) on invisibility trigger, and silently swallows all exceptions in attack().
findings.root_cause: `Service.gI().setPos2(this, ..., 10000)` passes 10000 as the Y coordinate (likely confused with duration), and `catch (Exception ex) {}` has an empty body.
findings.title: Yacon teleports to Y=10000 and swallows exceptions in attack()

findings.impact: Throws NPE if Pocolo's laze finishes after playerCall disconnects/leaves, or NPE in TrungUyTrang.leaveMap if zone is null; SuperBu forwards damage to Mabu2H even when SuperBu is already dead.
findings.root_cause: Pocolo.autoLeaveMap() accesses `playerCall.winSTT`/`setDie()` without checking null or online/zone status; TrungUyTrang.leaveMap() writes `this.zone.isTUTAlive = false` before `exitMap`; SuperBu.injured() calls Mabu2H.injured() before checking `!this.isDie()`.
findings.title: Missing null/alive guards in Pocolo, TrungUyTrang, and SuperBu

findings.impact: Long player IDs (>2^31-1) get truncated when stored as int for ChoRach/Xibachao rewards or ItemMap owner in CADICH; BaDo/ChoRach/Xibachao ignore actual player damage.
findings.root_cause: Casting `long` `bone.playerId` and `plKill.id` to `(int)`, and overwriting `damage` with `Util.nextInt(300, 500)` in BaDo/ChoRach/Xibachao.injured().
findings.title: Player ID (long->int) narrowing and fixed 300-500 damage override in NewBoss/CADICH

findings.impact: High maintenance burden and drift (e.g., SO3_NM.doneChatE missing break and waking two bosses, Mabu.java unused AO_TL/QUAN_TL/GANG_TL/GIAY_TL caches, Cadic/Goku dead petrifyPlayersInTheMap methods).
findings.root_cause: Copy-pasted reward(), attack(), autoLeaveMap(), and leaveMap() implementations across NamekGinyuForce (5 files), Nappa (3 files), RedRibbonHQ (6 files), and MajinBuu12H (5 files) instead of shared base/helper methods.
findings.title: Extensive copy-paste duplication and dead code across boss families

module_summary: Read all 33 boss implementation classes (5713 lines) across 9 boss packs: MajinBuu12H, MajinBuu14H, NamekGinyuForce, Nappa, NewBoss, RedRibbonHQ, SnakeWay, SuperDivineWater, and SuperRank. All classes extend Boss (or SuperRank -> Boss) and override lifecycle hooks (joinMap, afk, attack, injured, die, reward, autoLeaveMap, leaveMap). Primary risks center on thread-blocking loops/sleeps inside AI/injured hooks (SAIBAMEN.setBom busy-wait, CADICH/SAIBAMEN Functions.sleep), broken lethal/dodge/array-index logic (Drabura2, Cadic, Goku), missing null guards on plAtt/fightMabu/playerCall/zone, and pervasive (int) damage truncation and copy-paste duplication.
